title: Normalized dualizing transport over the restricted target
statement: Fix the finite purity setting P with coefficient ring A [def-pur-conventions]. Let f:X→Y and g:Z→Y be separated quasi-compact locally finite-type maps, and X,Z,Y Noetherian. Let aY:Y→Spec(k) be quasi-compact and locally of finite type, V an affine open in Y, N a normalized compact-support datum [def-sp-etale-compact-support-normalization], and U a Noetherian scheme. Let j:U→X and v:U→Z be separated etale maps with v≫g=j≫f. Let O⊆U be open with maps jO:O→f⁻¹V and vO:O→g⁻¹V satisfying jO≫(f⁻¹V).ι=O.ι≫j and vO≫(g⁻¹V).ι=O.ι≫v. Write fV=f|V, gV=g|V, nu for the ordinary/pro-etale comparison, and h=jO≫fV=vO≫gV. For omega(q)=nu*(Rq! of the monoidal unit) [def-pur-diagonal-orientation-refinement-data], construct L:jO*omega(fV)≅vO*omega(gV). First use the specified pullComparison to pass to ordinary coordinates, then apply normalized monoidal-unit locality for (jO,fV), equality transport from jO≫fV to vO≫gV, and inverse normalized locality for (vO,gV). Finally invert pullComparison for vO. No section invariant, alpha, rho, coefficient-unit change, deformation or orientation enters this construction.

def restrictedDualizingTransport (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u})
    {X Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Z ⟶ Y)
    [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    [IsSeparated g] [LocallyOfFiniteType g] [QuasiCompact g]
    [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian Z] [IsNoetherian Y]
    (aY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k)) [LocallyOfFiniteType aY] [QuasiCompact aY]
    (V : Y.affineOpens)
    (N : Etale.EtaleCompactSupportNormalization P.Coefficient)
    (U : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian U]
    (j : U ⟶ X) [Etale j] [IsSeparated j]
    (v : U ⟶ Z) [Etale v] [IsSeparated v]
    (w : v ≫ g = j ≫ f)
    (O : U.Opens) (jO : O.toScheme ⟶ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V.1).toScheme)
    (vO : O.toScheme ⟶ (g ⁻¹ᵁ V.1).toScheme)
    (hj : jO ≫ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V.1).ι = O.ι ≫ j)
    (hv : vO ≫ (g ⁻¹ᵁ V.1).ι = O.ι ≫ v) :
    (OrientationRefinement.pull P jO).obj
        (OrientationRefinement.omega P (f ∣_ V.1) (V.1.ι ≫ aY)) ≅
      (OrientationRefinement.pull P vO).obj
        (OrientationRefinement.omega P (g ∣_ V.1) (V.1.ι ≫ aY))
